title: Freight class
description: Freight classification anchored to the National Motor Freight Classification (NMFC), published by the NMFTA. Elective and NEVER default-on: composed only when an LTL / road shipment needs a declared freight class. Carries the declared NMFC class — the parties' assertion, verified off-chain against the NMFC standard (density is the primary driver, alongside stowability, handling, and liability) — plus the optional NMFC item number. The external standard is the source of truth; this clause references it, it does not compute the class.

fields.name: nmfcClass
fields.label: NMFC class
fields.description: Declared National Motor Freight Classification class (the 18 NMFC classes, 50–500). Density is the primary driver but not the only one — stowability, handling, and liability also bear on the class. The declaration is verified off-chain against the NMFC standard.

fields.name: nmfcItem
fields.label: NMFC item number
fields.description: Optional NMFC item / commodity number assigned by the NMFTA (e.g. "156600"). Identifies the specific commodity listing the class is drawn from.
